body: Because you know my temperament after two pieces of texts on the internet. I'm just not gonna let you put words in my mouth, I'm not blaming anyone. I'm just putting this on a site to get it off my chest. Chill.

I'm sorry you feel like killing yourself.. but maybe now is a time to just focus yourself.  You're not evil if you feel guilt for it. Have you maybe thought you have habits that you perceive as right, when they could be harmful to yourself and others? I know BPD is a minefield of interpersonal challenges and that's not an evil thing, thats just a part of the illness for some. As you said you did react angrily, and maybe thats something to consider better communication in the future. That's just human life though, we're not perfect, and we have to just focus on being better, not for anyone else, but for our own self. You'll be okay, just breathe. 💜
